svg.title: Three kinds of glitter. Cosmetic glitter, sold for face and body, with fine, smooth flakes: yes for skin, away from the eyes. Plant-cellulose bio glitter sold as a cosmetic, with soft plant-based flakes: yes for skin and lower-impact, but not harmless to nature. Craft glitter, sold for crafts with no ingredient list, with bigger, hard, sharp-edged flakes: never on skin.
